purpose: Reuse the frozen Phase A native collection/lifecycle diagnostic to compare the published baseline with the corrected local candidate; no new product optimization inferred in advance
order: Published then corrected, corrected then published, published then corrected; sequential owned processes only
identity: Published package must retain the original Phase A version/engine/hash validation. Corrected package must be an explicit full engine revision in a matching private local-version package, with native receipt SHA-256 checked against the executable
scope: 200 one-KiB documents, ten parallel collection reads, forty sequential gets, empty native start and one same-store reopen per run. Native process RSS only. Not full-data import/export, Storage, consumer performance or endurance qualification
decision: Preserve all runs, operation results, native RSS samples and failures. Review any observed regression before adopting another change; do not weaken any acceptance criterion, discard inconvenient samples, or claim a statistically established winner on a non-quiescent host
